# AI-Native Virtual Tabletop (VTT)

> An enterprise-grade virtual tabletop that decouples probabilistic LLM narrative
> generation from an authoritative deterministic Rust rules engine.

Every dice roll resolves through the deterministic engine, narration is audited
against mechanical state before it reaches players, and multiplayer state syncs
via CRDTs over WebSockets.

## Platform

- [Rules engine architecture](https://github.com/Heretek-AI/TTRPG#readme): pure Rust
  core — SRD 5.2 dice resolution, floored modifiers, death saves.
- [Multi-agent orchestrator](https://github.com/Heretek-AI/TTRPG#readme): FastAPI
  intent router, pre-commit invariant auditor, lore-graph grounding.
- [Realtime client](https://github.com/Heretek-AI/TTRPG#readme): React 18 + TypeScript,
  code-split per view, WebRTC voice mesh with 3D positional audio.

## Licensing & content

- [SRD attribution](https://github.com/Heretek-AI/TTRPG#readme): rules text derives
  from D&D 5e SRD under CC-BY-4.0 / Open Gaming License.

## Crawling policy

- [robots.txt](https://example.com/robots.txt): landing page is public; the
  tabletop app requires a session and API/WS endpoints are off-limits.
